summary: Implemented secure private-package consumption guidance, an external Angular fixture, static invariants, and protected BuildKit verification without consumer credentials in source or image configuration.

evidence.description: Single guide for local, Actions, Docker, diagnostic, rotation, and revocation flows.
Angular 22 consumer fixture outside workspaces, with parameterized .npmrc and a BuildKit-only Dockerfile.
Credential-free static fixture verification in ordinary CI.
Manual protected verification that scopes the repository secret to installation and image-inspection steps.
Streaming inspection that reports leakage without printing the credential.

validation.command: corepack yarn check:private-consumer && corepack yarn verify; inspector positive and negative stream tests
validation.details: Static fixture validation, full repository verification, and safe/leak detector tests passed. Direct fixture Angular compilation was not run locally because Node v24.9.0 is below Angular 22's supported v24.15.0 minimum; the protected workflow uses Node 22.22.3 and installs the published private package.
